skills.html:
Vitality
Level 2 · 1 skill point
A sturdier body: you can take more hits before you fall.
Gives
▲ +18 max health
Opens Hardened carapace

Quick step
Level 3 · 1 skill point
Quicker legs: you walk and turn faster.
Gives
▲ +6% speed
Opens Long stride

Silk sense
Level 4 · 1 skill point
A deeper silk reserve: more stamina for webs and pounces, and it refills faster.
Gives
▲ +12 max stamina (a web costs 12, a pounce 18)
▲ +0.8 stamina per second (base 8)
Opens Web crafter

Hardened carapace
Level 5 · 1 skill point
Needs Vitality
A denser shell: every hit you take lands softer.
Gives
▲ +2 armour: every hit you take is 2 lower
Opens Apex predator

Power strike
Level 6 · 1 skill point
Stronger chelicerae: every bite hits harder.
Gives
▲ +2 damage on every bite
Opens Apex predator

Web crafter
Level 8 · 1 skill point
Needs Silk sense
Practised spinning: more stamina, and it opens Silk tracking.
Gives
▲ +8 max stamina (a web costs 12, a pounce 18)
Opens Silk tracking

Silk tracking
Level 9 · 1 skill point
Needs Web crafter
Thrown silk corrects itself in flight and follows a moving target.
Gives
▲ Thrown silk steers after a moving target

Long stride
Level 10 · 1 skill point
Needs Quick step
Each step reaches further: you move faster still.
Gives
▲ +8% speed

Apex predator
Level 15 · 1 skill point
Needs Power strike, Hardened carapace
The peak of the hunt: much harder bites and a deep stamina reserve.
Gives
▲ +4 damage on every bite
▲ +16 max stamina (a web costs 12, a pounce 18)
